## Required

Only the four IDs linking the tag to its trip, set, catch and specimen. All tag details are optional.

## Available

One measured albacore has a five-character value that could be a tag identifier.

It does not tell us whether the tag was deployed or recovered, or what type it was.

## To decide

Confirm what the recorded number means, then reuse the same specimen ID as its length record.

Leave unsupported event, second-tag and finder details empty.

An empty sheet is structurally possible; the reporting rule remains open. Do not create an unsupported ID-only row.

[Detailed review](ll-18-e-set-tag-details.html) · [Short review index](ll-sheet-summaries.html).
